changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.comment: Remove the tutor, editor and instructor authorities from all users and from the authority table. Teaching roles live in user_course_role.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO jhi_user_authority (user_id, authority_name) SELECT DISTINCT teaching.user_id, 'ROLE_USER' FROM jhi_user_authority teaching LEFT JOIN jhi_user_authority ordinary ON ordinary.user_id = teaching.user_id AND ordinary.authority_name = 'ROLE_USER' WHERE teaching.authority_name IN ('ROLE_TA', 'ROLE_EDITOR', 'ROLE_INSTRUCTOR') AND ordinary.user_id IS NULL

rollback.stop: The global teaching authorities are no longer used. They can be derived from user_course_role again by inserting the three authority rows and, for every user, one row per role held in at least one course.
